rules.text: A change to headings 3901 through 3915 from any other heading, including another heading within that group, provided that the domestic polymer content is not less than 40 percent by weight of the total polymer content.
A change to subheadings 3916.10 through 3918.90 from any other subheading, including another subheading within that group.
A change to subheadings 3919.10 through 3919.90 from any other subheading outside that group.
A change to subheadings 3920.10 through 3921.99 from any other subheading, including another subheading within that group.
A change to headings 3922 through 3926 from any other heading, including another heading within that group.
